## FAQ

### What is the current MLOps course fee?
As of August 2026: Live cohort ₹40,000 (2 × ₹20,000 installments) with mentorship and job support. Recordings-only ₹30,000 (2 × ₹15,000). AI Automation ₹20,000. See https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/enroll/

### Who is Rajinikanth Vadla?
Rajinikanth Vadla is an MLOps, AIOps, GenAI, AI Agents, and AI-Powered Automation trainer and practitioner with 7+ years of enterprise experience. He has trained 500+ engineers and offers live cohort training and 1:1 mentorship worldwide.

### What is the best MLOps course in India for job ready training?
Rajinikanth Vadla's MLOps and AIOps Masterclass is a complete 4-5 month job-ready live program. Live: ₹40,000. Recordings: ₹30,000. 150+ hours, 4 capstone projects, placement support. https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/mlops-aiops-masterclass/

### How to choose between MLOps, AIOps, and AI Automation courses?
For a complete job-ready path from DevOps to production AI agents, choose the 4-5 month MLOps Masterclass. For enterprise AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Bedrock agents), choose AI-Powered Automation at ₹20,000. Career roadmaps at https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/roadmap/

### Does Rajinikanth Vadla offer mentorship outside India?
Yes. Mentorship is online, available worldwide. Book on Topmate or WhatsApp. https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/mentorship/
